_doc: GS1 ignore-list for the PHP↔Kotlin action-log compare gate (compare-command-logs.mjs). The matched set is the 28 committed PHP-captured P2 goldens (logic/src/test/resources/golden/p2/*.json). Two ignore mechanisms: (1) `IgnoreCommands` drops a WHOLE command key from the matched set — the 12 backlogged P2 commands (tools/php-golden/p2-capture-backlog.md, scenario_1010 state gaps, NOT failures) + the ~57-of-93 non-P2 commands; (2) `Global`/per-command `templates`+`regex` drop individual log lines that survive the scope filters but are not part of the action-log surface being gated (broadcast/dest/guard lines that leak through). Kept verbatim from legacy/devsam-core2026/tools/compare-command-logs.ignore.json where applicable.
_ignoreCommandsDoc: The 12 P2 commands backlogged in p2-capture-backlog.md: opening-restriction/age/troop/sub-max-capital state gaps in the pristine scenario_1010 install (no actor can satisfy their PHP preconditions without fabricating a computed input) OR a seed-fragile unique-item-lottery seam (che_랜덤임관). On the GS1 ignore-list, NOT failures. When a backlogged command becomes capturable (clock advanced, troop/aged general added, sub-max capital), it is removed from this list and joins the captured matched set.

che_장비매매._doc: The Kotlin che_장비매매 resolver inlines the 도기-item sell hook (`재산과 국고에 총 …을 보충합니다.`), whose PHP grand truth lives in ActionItem/che_보물_도기.php:61 (`onArbitraryAction`), NOT in Command/General/che_장비매매.php. The command-file PHP extractor structurally cannot reach the ActionItem tree, so this byte-faithful item-hook line shows as Kotlin-only — an extractor SCOPE artifact, not a parity bug (legacy ignore-list likewise carried a General/che_장비매매 entry). The buy/sell lines themselves byte-match.
